extension.summary: Drive WLED strips from Kodi video edges
extension.description: Samples the Kodi framebuffer and sends edge colors to a WLED controller over DDP. Built for CoreELEC on Amlogic boxes such as the Ugoos AM9 Pro. Does not sit in the HDMI path.
extension.news: 0.1.0 - Initial service, WLED JSON probe, DDP sender, RenderCapture sampler.
